name: Pedro Abad (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided purple over cream, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pedro Abad (a bull on white, a chequy field and a cauldron).
history: Municipal flag of Pedro Abad; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pedro Abad arms — bull, chequy and cauldron
